petrol.source: Delhi retail price on 26 Oct 2026: ₹102.12 a litre in Goodreturns and Business Today, unchanged since at least 16 Oct (goodreturns.in/petrol-price-in-new-delhi.html, businesstoday.in/fuel-price/petrol-price-in-delhi-today). Indian Oil publishes city prices only by SMS (RSP 102090 to 92249 92249 for Delhi) and its app. Changes daily at 6 am; check at your pump.

cng.source: Indraprastha Gas Limited (IGL), the city gas distributor for Delhi: raised to ₹86.98/kg from ₹83.09 with effect from 6 am on 29 Aug 2026 (PTI report, 29 Aug 2026, dtnext.in). Still ₹86.98 on 23 Oct 2026 per Goodreturns. IGL's own price page still shows its April 2023 notice.
